bio_en: Serob of Sulukh, called Aryuts ('the Lion'), was a wealthy and influential villager of Sulukh in the Mush plain, aged about 40-45 at his death. He joined the ARF in Aghbyur Serob's time and organised his own and neighbouring villages. In January 1901, rather than rot in a Turkish prison, he sold part of his property and went up to Andranik in Sasun with his two sons and his weapons; in 1902 he went with them to the Caucasus. In 1903 he joined a band crossing back and was killed, weapon in hand, with his two sons in the last fights at Basen.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Not to be confused with Aghbyur Serob.
